title: Output Schema for SendMessage Operation
description: Output schema for the sendMessage operation in the connector.

payload.description: The main response payload from the sendMessage operation.

MD5OfMessageBody.description: An MD5 digest of the message body string.

MD5OfMessageAttributes.description: An MD5 digest of the message attributes. Only returned if message attributes were sent.

MessageId.description: A unique identifier for the sent message.

SequenceNumber.description: The sequence number that SQS assigned to the message. Only returned for messages sent to FIFO queues.

operationSuccessful.description: Indicates whether the SQS API call was successful.

requestId.description: The AWS request ID for the SQS operation.
